Sulfur Wastes is the southern half of the sulfur-dominated lowlands of Zaralek Cavern, with Acidbite Ravine as the northern half. The wastes surround the Ruins of Drekazera, where the Researchers Under Fire public scenario takes place every hour at the bottom of the hour. The Sulfur Sprint dragonriding race takes place at just east of the Gaze of Neltharion. The wastes are bordered by the Gaze of Neltharion and Acidbite Ravine to the north, Loamm to the northeast, the Crystal Fields to the southeast, Cascades Column to the south, Dragonscale Camp and the Viridian Throne to the southwest, Molten Overflow to the west, and Burning Oasis and Igira's Watch to the northwest. In Warcraft Lore, the word "Sulfuron" refers to more than one thing. *Sulfuron Hammer - An epic weapon, needed for the legendary weapon Sulfuras, Hand of Ragnaros. *Sulfuron Harbinger - A boss in the Molten Core. *Sulfuron Ingot - A reagent needed to forge the aforementioned Sulfuron Hammer. *Sulfuron Keep - Ragnaros' stronghold in the Firelands, in the Elemental Plane. *Sulfuron Spire - Ragnaros' stronghold in Mount Hyjal.

Suncrown Village is a ruined high elven village, located in the northeastern area of the Ghostlands. Every year, the village's denizens would take part in a ritual to keep the different aspects of nature under their control; their dominion over the element of water was symbolized by the summoning and enslavement of an elemental named Aquantion, who eventually subverted the elves' spellcasting and slew them, enslaving their spirits beneath the water. The elven residents are drowned and haunt at the nearby lake. It is now home to a group of crypt fiends led by Anok'suten.
__NOTOC__ Summoner Teli'Larien is a blood elf warlock trainer located at the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle in Eversong Woods.

Summoner's Blade is a quest reward from Varedis Must Be Stopped (Aldor) / Varedis Must Be Stopped (Scryers).

Summoned Daemon is a piece in the Chess Event in Karazhan that takes the place of a Rook for the Horde side. It is a reference to the daemon of the warlock units in Warcraft: Orcs & Humans. The model used for this mob is that of a doomguard, which fits with speculation that the daemons of the first two Warcraft games are, in fact, ered'ruin.
Summoner's Wand drops from Dalaran Summoners at Dalaran Crater in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
Sunderseer Mantle is a pair of Level 55 quality Cloth Shoulderpads that improve Intellect, Stamina and Versatility.
Suncrown Breastplate can be purchased from Provisioner Vredigar in the Ghostlands after reaching with Tranquillien.

The Summoned Old God was an Old God that was being summoned by the Dark Conclave to Outland. The summoning ritual was interrupted by an adventurer and the ritualists massacred. This Old God is not related to the ones trapped on Azeroth.

The Summertide Assaults were a series of large battles between the Undead Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade, which took place over the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades. The battle's outcome signaled a major defeat for Scourge plans to seize the Monastery, with the Scarlet defenders maintaining control of the complex.
Sun-touched Chain Leggings are epic mail legs armor for shamans.

*Population: 400 (400 Nerubian) The Sundered Monolith is an enormous Nerubian citadel that serves as a major community for the survivors of the fall of Azjol-Nerub. Buried under the ice of the Dragonblight in Northrend, this community of exiles dreams of the day when the glory of their race may be restored. Naturally xenophobic, their hatred of the Scourge and desire for revenge might be enough to help a quick-witted adventurer win some much-needed aid - but if they fail, a quick death is likely to be their fate. The Sundering is a massive whirlpool located in the middle of Stranglethorn Vale, dividing it into Northern Stranglethorn and the Cape of Stranglethorn. The vortex was created by the Cataclysm, one of many geographical changes that it caused. Li Li Stormstout remarked, about the Sundering, that "The road in this part of the world could use some improvement," Li Li huffed. Would it have killed them to put up a sign? 'Warning: Path ahead disappears into a giant whirlpool of death'!"

Summon Infernal is a Destruction warlock talent that summons an Infernal minion to be the player's temporary guardian. The Infernal is summoned in addition to the warlock's current minion, but despawns after 30 seconds. It attacks with Immolation.
Summon Sunwalker Kodo summons a kodo for the Paladin to mount and pursue justice at blinding speeds. It cost to learn at level 20.

Summon Doomguard is a level 58 warlock spell that summons a Doomguard minion to be the player's temporary guardian. The Doomguard is summoned in addition to the warlock's current minion, but despawns after 25 seconds. It becomes a permanent pet with the Grimoire of Supremacy talent.

These long-sleeved, woolen tunics are threaded with with tubes leading to a small phlogiston boiler that hangs from the belt of the wearer. The boiler runs heated water through the tubes to keep the wearer "as warm as a summer day" even in the coldest weather. The flow of water may be adjusted such that the wearer feels anywhere between 1 and 60 degrees warmer than the outside environment.

This buckle can be attached to any belt and operates like a normal belt buckle. When a secret catch is pressed, however, the face of the buckle flips open and flash powder inside the buckle is ignited.

Sun Priest Asaris is a tol'vir quest giver located outside of Ramkahen in the contested territory of Uldum. He sends adventurers to battle the Wastewander Bandits in the region, reclaim the four Relics of the Sun King, and to gather ingredients to heal Iset.
Sun of a.... is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Rajh before he completes an entire recharging phase in the Halls of Origination on Heroic difficulty.
Sunderfury's Sundries drop from the rare at Black Breach in the Twilight Highlands.

__NOTOC__ Summit Bonestrippers are vultures found in Yaungol Advance in Kun-Lai Summit. They are also present during the events of the Assault in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Summit Prowlers are found in Kun-Lai Summit. They can be found sleeping, hunting, or watching over their cubs.

Summit Prowler Cubs are found in Kun-Lai Summit. They can be found sleeping or playing, always with a parent nearby. Their adult form is Summit Prowler. Although they are hostile, they will not aggro unless provoked.
Suna Silentstrike is a Shado-Pan rogue and scout. She plays a major role in the Shado-Pan quest chain in Kun-Lai Summit and Townlong Steppes.

Summer is the tiger pet of Lorewalker Cho. Summer is first seen at the Dreamer's Pavilion in the Jade Forest. She is next seen accompanying Cho and Lorewalkers at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. As fitting for a cat, she is usually seen sleeping.

Sun Tenderheart was a pandaren quest giver aligned with the Golden Lotus, found in the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Sun was killed in the destruction of the vale caused by Garrosh Hellscream's reawakening of the Sha of Pride. Following her death, Sun's corrupted spirit can be encountered as one of The Fallen Protectors in the Siege of Orgrimmar raid.

Sun Priest Iset is a Ramkahen tol'vir found dying at the Seal of the Sun King in Uldum. In his attempt to defend the area from Wastewander bandits, he was poisoned by them and left for dead. Sun Priest Asaris tries to save him using the venom from Venomblood Scorpids to make an antidote. The adventurer who aids them leaves before finding out if Iset is saved or not.
Suncrawlers can be found at the bases of trees north of Anglers Wharf in Krasarang Wilds.
Sunblossom Hill lies in between Mistfall Village and the Setting Sun Garrison in southeast Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Thundermaw wolves make the hill their home.

The Thalassian Warhorse is a type of horse used by a blood elf paladin as a mount. It is learned automatically at level 10. The epic mount for blood elf paladins is called Summon Thalassian Charger.
Summer Lily is a pandaren found in Mandori Village on the Wandering Isle. She sometimes pray at the graves.

Summons to Orgrimmar begins the Wound quest chain, introducing players to Silithus: The Wound. It is offered to players after they have completed the Argus the Unmaker encounter in Antorus, the Burning Throne. It will be offered automatically immediately after logging back in. Additionally, level 110 characters who have not defeated Argus were offered this quest the week of June 24th, 2018 after their region's typical weekly maintenance.

Summons to Stormwind begins the Wound quest chain, introducing players to Silithus: The Wound. It is offered to players after they have completed the Argus the Unmaker encounter in Antorus, the Burning Throne. It will be offered automatically immediately after logging back in. Additionally, level 110 characters who have not defeated Argus were offered this quest the week of June 24th, 2018 after their region's typical weekly maintenance.
